name: SALIC API (Lei Rouanet cultural-incentive system)
tier_rationale: Federal ministry publishing the Lei Rouanet incentive data as an open API (government body, A8 trusted); P246 'Official open data (BNDES, MinC, PNCP), tier trusted' (cond 5).

reliability.justification: The ministry's own incentive register (sponsors, projects, donations); totals are as published by SALIC.

salic_incentivadores.title: SALIC incentivadores by CNPJ (HAL JSON _embedded.incentivadores with total_doado and the doacoes link)

terms.quote: Official open data (BNDES, MinC, PNCP), tier trusted.

salic_incentivadores.notes: Quote: binding council text (P246 cond 5); research C0579 terms 'Open government API (MinC)' (verified_live 200, 2026-11-26). Only GET /api/v1/incentivadores?cgccpf=<14-digit CNPJ>: the proponentes/fornecedores name searches reach individuals and are never used, and natural-person sponsors and the 'responsavel' field are never matched, stored or pivoted (P246 cond 4). A 404 whose body carries message_code 11 ('No donator was found with your criteria', about 7.5 s) is the documented absence; any other 404 body is 'could not verify'. Used by br_public_spending.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-2 (P246 br_public_spending). Behind Cloudflare; 1 request/s, answers cached 24 h; the not-found answer takes about 7.5 s, hence the 20 s timeout. No quota block.
